title: Fork Inn Covered Bridge Farmhouse, Room (#4)
description:
Remote country estate set in rural paradise.
Historic wood structures set amid 95 acre estate.
Private room in shared house
Shared bathroom and kitchen

The space
Just look at the pictures.
Estate is part of the 2000 acre Big East Fork Conservation Easement.

Guest access
You may use the kitchen, dining room and roam about the farm, stable, and 95 acres of land. A babling stream lies just under the covered bridge.

During your stay
I check in on my guests to make sure everything is going well and mutual expectations are being met.

Other things to note
You must pay the 3% County and 9.5% State taxes before your check-in. Paaypal works great.

All guests must demonstrate Government issued ID and show their face on their profile picture.

host_details:
We are the proud owners of The Fork Inn in 3000 acre Big East Fork Valley. We are in a protected watershed located 19 miles west of Nashville and 10 miles north of Franklin. 

We are honored to be Stewards of Big East Fork Valley and support the nearby Center for Sustainable Stewardship. We enjoy the abundant wildlife and the many nearby creeks and hiking trails.

We look forward to your stay
